Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — HaloITSM and Ivanti Neurons for ITSM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose HaloITSM only if your buying job matches “All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onboarding packages extr” rather than Ivanti Neurons for ITSM's shape. Choose Ivanti Neurons for ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does n” rather than HaloITSM's shape. Workflow advantage differs because HaloITSM is shaped for All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onbo whereas Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is shaped for Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — HaloITSM and Ivanti Neurons for ITSM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: HaloITSM is All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onboarding packages extra. Does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 / Freshservice ; Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 / Freshservice 8.4..
- Company-size focus: HaloITSM (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Ivanti Neurons for ITSM (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: HaloITSM — £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list; Ivanti Neurons for ITSM — No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU.

Limitations — HaloITSM: £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list; Onboarding packages stack on the agent SKU; Ivanti Neurons for ITSM: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4).

Poor-fit cases: HaloITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list · Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU · Avoid HaloITSM if you actually need Ivanti Neurons for ITSM's motion (Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public li)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
